entries.bae8f9e5d337d53e: This is the business with the largest revenue from external customers, engaged in power generation and retail electricity business in Japan (¥656,298 million for the fiscal year ended March 2026). The company generates electricity at hydroelectric and thermal power plants and sells it to households and businesses, mainly in the three prefectures of Hokuriku and parts of Gifu Prefecture. The company also purchases electricity from affiliated companies engaged in power generation, such as its subsidiary Nihonkai Power Co., Ltd.
